name: 逸侠世界
english_description: Daniel's World (逸俠之世界), part of the ES II engine family, produced in Taiwan (BBS 140.127.179.161; contact leonguo@tpts4.seed.net.tw). Unusually for this corpus, new characters start on a modern campus (classrooms, a courtyard garden, a lab building, a kitchen, a bike rack) rather than the usual wuxia inn or martial hall, and the world folds in scenes and NPCs from Taiwan's Pili Puppetry (霹靂布袋戲) glove-puppet franchise alongside the standard jianghu backdrop. Registration runs through an English ID, Chinese name, password with confirmation, email, and gender. Shares the same codebase, title, and contact email with this collection's yxzsj, an independent build from a different point in the same game's history (not a byte-identical repackaging).
